tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Build CIF Library
tool.description: build a reusable mini or augmented candidate library
tool.command: touch '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p cif_inputs library_output && #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_files) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for library_args=(python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py build-library --cif-dir cif_inputs --library-mode '$library_mode' --radiation '$radiation') && #if str($library_mode) == 'augmented' library_args+=(--base-db-root "\${RADAR_PD_DB_ROOT}/database_${radiation}") && #end if library_args+=(--output-root library_output --manifest-output '$library_manifest' --archive '$library_archive') && #if str($overwrite) not in ('', 'None', 'False') library_args+=($overwrite) && #end if "\${library_args[@]}" > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)
tool.help: Builds a portable RADAR-PD library from a Galaxy list collection of CIF files. "Only my CIFs" creates a compact standalone library. "Built-in + my CIFs" requires the NDIP deployment to mount the matching built-in catalog read-only in the RADAR-PD container. The resulting ZIP can be selected as the candidate library in RADAR-PD Analyze and preserved in Galaxy history for reuse.
